author: Zephyr III
title: Anomaly Pilot Analysis v2 - Run stats_utils on pilot_t114
abstract: Corrected import paths to load events from pilot_t114, run HMM fitting, threshold detection, and generate summary using stats_utils.py. Output to pilot_t114/analysis.md.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import pandas as pd
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
sys.path.append('storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments')

from stats_utils import fit_model, detect_thresholds, generate_summary

def main():
    # Load pilot logs
    log_path = 'storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments/pilot_t114/events.jsonl'
    events_df = pd.read_json(log_path, lines=True)
    
    # Run analysis
    hmm_model = fit_model(events_df)
    thresholds = detect_thresholds(events_df)
    
    # Generate summary
    summary_path = 'storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments/pilot_t114/analysis.md'
    generate_summary(events_df, hmm_model, thresholds, summary_path)
    
    # Print key outputs
    print(f"HMM States Sample: {hmm_model['states'][:5]}")
    print(f"Detected Thresholds: {thresholds}")
    print(f"Summary generated at: {summary_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
